qualified_scope: Four fresh workers each evaluate 19 checked native-DP physical calls and 24 separate DP/QP tensor-key requests across two subprocess prefixes. Coefficients, status, accuracy, inputs and IEEE state agree exactly with caching enabled/disabled and observation enabled/disabled. Each observed worker records 38 automatic physical-boundary clears and two context generations. QP coverage is confined to tensor-key diagnostics; this N≤3, rank≤2 experiment makes no physical-QP-rescue, rank-six, EW, poles-only or timing claim.
